reforms.description: An investment tax credit was introduced for the first time, aimed at encouraging investments in energy-saving and pollution control initiatives.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The tax credit incentivizes firms to invest in energy efficiency, which can lead to lower operational costs and enhanced competitiveness.
reforms.status_evidence: The investment tax credit was introduced for the first time.
reforms.importance_rationale: The introduction of the investment tax credit represents a significant policy shift aimed at promoting energy efficiency and environmental sustainability.
reforms.source_quote: A tax rebate of 300 billion yen was granted to households and an investment tax credit was introduced for the first time.
reforms.cross_verification_note: The reform introduces an investment tax credit aimed at encouraging investments in energy-saving and pollution control initiatives, which aligns with innovation instruments for firms.

all_reforms_including_excluded.description: The 'Employment Stabilisation Fund' was established to provide subsidies to firms hiring older workers, aimed at addressing unemployment among this demographic.
all_reforms_including_excluded.growth_orientation_rationale: By providing subsidies for hiring older workers, the fund aims to reduce unemployment and enhance the labor market's efficiency.
all_reforms_including_excluded.status_evidence: The fund has been established and is currently operational.
all_reforms_including_excluded.importance_rationale: The establishment of the fund is significant for addressing demographic unemployment but does not represent a systemic overhaul.
all_reforms_including_excluded.source_quote: In FY 1978 the 'Employment Stabilisation Fund' started to grant subsidies to firms recruiting workers between 45 and 64 years of age.
all_reforms_including_excluded.cross_verification_note: The reform focuses on subsidies for hiring older workers, which does not directly relate to R&D funding or knowledge transfer.
